messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — during the P0 earlier the paging handoff didn't escalate to secondary. Primary got the page but was on DND. We recovered but this created a ~12min blind spot. Need a quick post-incident review + concrete action items. Can we also update the incident-bot to create action-tracker entries automatically when a postmortem is requested? @Simon Lee @Maria Gonzalez

oncall-bot: Incident INC-789 resolved by @eng-oncall. Timeline & logs: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-789. Root cause: autoscaler storm + race in GPU allocation; paging flow: primary paged, escalation to secondary failed (DND).

Maria Gonzalez: +1. Can we do a short PM tomorrow 10:00 PT to run through timeline and actions? Who can own the writeup?

Simon Lee: I can own the writeup. Proposed lightweight process so we don't stall:
- Use compact template: what, timeline, impact, RCA, action items (owner + due date).
- Bot automation: slash command to create postmortem scaffold + GH issue for action items.
- Auto-DM assignees and add items to tracker dashboard.

Simon Lee: Example slash command I'd like the bot to accept:
```
/incident create-postmortem INC-789 --owner @simon --template minimal --notify @ops
```

Jess Support: Add customer-impact section. I can collate affected accounts and notification timestamps. We should include which customers got degraded throughput vs full outage.

ProductOps: Need SLA metrics and # of affected customers for the PM. Alex — can you drop numbers here so Simon can include?

Alex Chen: Quick numbers: error rate spike +0.6% over baseline for ~12m, 24 customers saw degraded throughput, 2 enterprise customers had latency >2s for >5m. I'll paste exact query and results into the draft doc in a bit.

Simon Lee: For automation here's a simple webhook idea we can expose to infra: 
```
POST /internal/incidents/webhook
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "incident_id":"INC-789",
  "create_postmortem": true,
  "postmortem_owner":"simon"
}
```
Infra can then create the GH issue + attach the timeline. Would avoid manual steps.

Maria Gonzalez: Tracker fields we need for the dashboard: [incident_id, short_description, owner, due_date, status, severity, sla_impact, link_to_postmortem, notification_status]. Use these exact keys so the dashboard can ingest automatically.

oncall-bot: Created GitHub issue #1423 for INC-789: "Improve paging escalation for DND" — assigned to @network-ops. Link: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/issues/1423

Alex Chen: Owner assignments (proposed): Simon -> postmortem writeup (due 72h), Maria -> update runbook + escalation doc (due 1 week), Jess -> customer comms + ticket bundle (due 24h), EngInfra -> implement webhook + bot changes (owner @infra, due 2 weeks). I can own SLA numbers and final review.

EngInfra Bot: Noted. Creating internal ticket INF-789-Actions and scheduling a spike to add webhook endpoints and bot handlers. Will post ETA in the infra channel.

ProductOps: Calendar invite sent for postmortem review: 2026-03-16 10:00 PT. Please accept.

Simon Lee: Draft postmortem link: https://notion.redwood/pm/INC-789-draft — I'll drop timeline and initial RCA there tonight.

Jess Support: I'll add the customer notification draft to the doc and tag legal for review if necessary.

Maria Gonzalez: Small bot UX idea: when a PM is created the bot should DM each assignee with a summary + link and add a reminder at due_date - 48h and -24h. Also, if overdue, escalate to the team's manager.

Simon Lee: +1. Also propose an "action-state" field we can sync back to Slack so the bot can post weekly summaries to #incidents-dashboard. Example: `action_state: open|in-progress|blocked|done`.

Alex Chen: Quick log excerpt that shows the escalation failure (for the doc):
```
[2026-03-15T14:12:06Z] paging-service: escalate user=oncall.primary -> oncall.secondary status=skipped reason=DND
[2026-03-15T14:12:18Z] autoscaler: gpu-request failed id=abc123 retry=1
```

oncall-bot: All assignees notified: @simon @maria @jess @infra. GH issue & infra ticket linked.

Alex Chen: TL;DR action list (I'll follow up in GH issue #1423):
- Simon: postmortem draft (72h)
- Maria: runbook update (1 week)
- Jess: customer comms (24h)
- EngInfra: webhook + bot changes (2 weeks)
- Alex: SLA numbers & final review (48h)

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — let's treat the automation as a priority so future handoffs create less toil. I'll ping infra on the ticket and we'll review in tomorrow's PM. :thumbsup:
